BomGroup.description: Sources shared by Components on a grouped BOM row.

oneOf.description: All Component value fields, including manufacturer and supplier numbers.
The Component field with this name.

BomLayout.description: One BOM row per group or per Component.

oneOf.description: One row per group of Components sharing `group_by`.

BomSettings.description: A Fab Preset's BOM: its columns and row conventions.

columns.description: The columns, Source → Header, in file order.

designator_separator.description: What joins a row's Designators, which are never written as ranges.

group_by.description: What a grouped row's Components share.

layout.description: Grouped rows or one row per Component.

line_numbers.description: The line-number column's start and step.

list_unplaced.description: Whether footprintless Mechanical Components on a sheet are listed.

mount_values.description: The spellings of the mount column.

not_fitted.description: Whether Not Fitted Components are listed.

required_fields.description: Fields whose missing value warns; the row stays, and Mechanical rows are skipped.

sort.description: The row order, by these columns in turn.

BottomPosition.description: How a bottom-side part's position is written.

oneOf.description: Positions as seen from the top.

BottomRotation.description: How a bottom-side part's stored rotation θ is written.

oneOf.description: θ as stored: a part at 30° flipped to the bottom writes 330.

Column.description: One column of a BOM or CPL file.

header.description: The column header, such as "LCSC Part #".

ColumnSource.description: Where a BOM or CPL column takes its values from.

oneOf.description: The Designators of the row, in natural order (CPL: the one Designator).
How many Components the BOM row groups.
The mount type, spelled with the BOM's `mount_values`.
Footprint copper-Pad bounding box centre, X, from the output origin.
Footprint copper-Pad bounding box centre, Y.
The Footprint's rotation in degrees, counter-clockwise.
The Component field with this name, such as `LCSC` or `MPN`.

CplSettings.description: A Fab Preset's CPL: its columns and position conventions.

bottom_position.description: How a bottom-side part's position is written.

bottom_rotation.description: How a bottom-side part's rotation is written.

columns.description: The columns, Source → Header, in file order.

exclude_through_hole.description: Leaves out Footprints with a plated through-hole Pad.

side_values.description: The spellings of the side column.

unit_suffix.description: Whether the unit follows each position.

units.description: The unit positions are written in.

CrossReferenceStyles.description:
How a Port cross-reference names its partners' places: by sheet, then by location on
that sheet.

path.description:
The Document's file name, relative to the Project folder; its stem is the
Document's name and its extension its kind.

ErcSeverities.description:
The severity of every ERC check, stored in the Project. A check left out has its
default.

dangling_wire.description: A Wire end that touches nothing.

duplicate_designator.description: Several Components with the same Designator.

duplicate_nets.description:
Different Nets with the same board name, such as one Net Label on two sheets. It
blocks Sync.

net_names_across_sheets.description: One Net with different names on different sheets.

net_names_on_sheet.description:
One Net with different names on one sheet; names differing only in case are one
name.

net_tie_one_net.description: A Net Tie with all its Pins on one Net, so the tie does nothing.

no_connect_connected.description: A No-Connect Marker on a Pin that is connected.

pin_conflict.description: Drivers fighting on a Net: Output and Power Out Pins together.

pin_conflict_mixed.description: Pin types that should not mix on a Net, such as Tri-state and Output.

single_pin_net.description: A wired Net with only one Pin.

single_sheet_port.description: A Port whose name no other sheet has.

unattached_label.description: A Net Label or Port attached to nothing.

unconnected_input.description: An Input or Power In Pin connected to nothing.

unconnected_pin.description:
A Pin of another type connected to nothing. Not Connected Pins and Pins with a
No-Connect Marker are exempt.

undriven_power.description: A Net with Power In Pins and no Power Out Pin or Power Port.

unit_data_mismatch.description: Units of one Component whose Component data differ.

unplaced_units.description: Units of a placed multi-unit Component left unplaced.

FabRules.description:
A Fab Preset's design rules: flat limits with no scope, which a job compares the board
with, and the preferred values a new board's routing starts from.

annular_ring.description: Minimum annular ring of Vias and plated Pads.

clearance.description: Minimum clearance between copper of different Nets.

edge_clearance.description: Minimum clearance from copper to the Board Outline and Board Cutouts.

hole_max.description: Maximum Pad, Free Pad and non-plated hole.

hole_min.description: Minimum Pad, Free Pad and non-plated hole.

mask_expansion.description: The Solder Mask expansion and Via tenting a new board starts with.

paste_expansion.description: The paste expansion a new board starts with.

preferred.description:
The preferred sizes a new board is seeded with. They are never compared with the
board.

FileNaming.description: How the Gerber and drill files of a job are named.

oneOf.description: Classic extensions: `.gtl`, `.gbl`, `.gts`, … and `.gm1` for the Profile.
The project and Layer name, ending in `.gbr`.

FileOrigin.description: Where Gerber, drill and CPL coordinates are measured from, for all three together.

oneOf.description:
The Output Origin if one is placed on the PCB Document, otherwise the lower-left
corner of the Board Outline's bounding box.

GerberSettings.description: The Gerber and drill switches of a Fab Preset.

file_names.description: Layer name to output file name; portable between boards and Projects.

file_origin.description: Where coordinates are measured from; shared by Gerber, drill and CPL.

merge_drill.description: One drill file with plated and non-plated holes, instead of PTH and NPTH.

outline_on_every_plot.description: Adds the Board Outline to every Gerber plot.

slot_command.description: How the drill file writes slots.

x2_attributes.description: Write Gerber X2 attributes (`.FileFunction` and friends); off writes plain X1.

LayerFileName.description: A Layer whose Gerber file gets its own name.

layer.description: The Layer's name, so the override carries between boards and Projects.

name.description: The file name to write that Layer's Gerber as.

step.description: The increase from one row to the next.

LocationStyle.description: How a cross-reference names where on its sheet a partner is.

oneOf.description: By its Border Zone, such as `B3`; nothing on a sheet with Border Zones off.
By its X,Y position on the sheet, in millimetres.

MaskExpansion.description: The board's solder-mask seed values. Tenting here applies only to Vias.

bottom.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

top.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

MountValues.description: The spellings of the mount column.

smt.description: The mount column for a Footprint with no plated through-hole Pad.

tht.description: The mount column for a Footprint with any plated through-hole Pad.

NotFittedBom.description: Whether the BOM lists Not Fitted Components.

oneOf.description: Not Fitted Components are left out.
Not Fitted Components get their own rows with quantity 0.

NotFittedPaste.description: Whether this build retains Not Fitted Components' paste openings.

oneOf.description: Not Fitted Pads keep their paste openings, so one stencil serves every build.
Not Fitted Pads lose their paste openings.

OutputJob.description: A named recipe for manufacturing files, stored in the Project file.

destination.description:
The output folder relative to the Project folder, `/`-separated; left out for
`outputs/<job name>`.

fab_preset.description: The Project copy of the Fab Preset it uses.

name_template.description:
The zip and assembly files' stem, resolved with the shared text resolver. Checked
on load like on `output.job.add`/`set`.

not_fitted_paste.description: Whether Not Fitted Pads keep their paste openings in this build.

pcb.description:
The PCB Document it plots. A job whose PCB Document is gone is broken until it is
pointed at another.

schematic_pdf_colour.description: The schematic PDF in colour or mono.

Outputs.description: Which files an Output Job writes.

drill.description: Excellon drill files, plated and non-plated.

gerber.description: Gerber files for copper, mask, paste, silkscreen and the Board Outline.

reports.description: The DRC, ERC and Change List reports.

expansion.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

PasteExpansion.description: The board's paste seed: length per edge or signed change in area in percent.

PdfColour.description: The schematic PDF's paper colour mode.

PreferredSeeds.description: The preferred Track and Via sizes a Fab Preset seeds a new board with.

ProjectFabPreset.description:
The Project's own copy of a Fab Preset, so outputs come out the same on any machine.
Its fields are a [`FabPreset`]'s, after the UUID.

name.description: The name of the preset it was copied from.

ProjectProperties.description:
The Project properties: fixed free-text fields that fill each sheet's title block. The
board thickness and copper are the PCB Document's [`crate::Stackup`].

SchematicOptions.description: The Project's schematic options: how Nets are named and Ports cross-referenced.

allow_ports_to_name_nets.description:
Allow Ports to Name Nets. Off, a Port still joins its Net across sheets but never
names it.

append_sheet_numbers.description:
Append Sheet Numbers to Local Nets: every Local Net named by a Net Label gets the
board name `<name>_<n>`, `n` being its sheet's number. Sheets keep showing the plain
name.

cross_reference_styles.description: The Project's cross-reference styles, unless it follows the Preferences.

cross_references.description:
Automatic Cross References: each Port shows where its partners are, such as
`[2:B3]`. Off by default, so a Project opts in.

cross_references_follow_preferences.description:
Follow Cross References settings in Preferences: the styles come from the
Preferences instead of [`SchematicOptions::cross_reference_styles`]. Off by default.

power_port_names_priority.description:
Power Port Names Take Priority: a Power Port's name beats a Net Label's, giving
Power Port > Net Label > Port > auto-name. Off by default (Net Label > Power Port >
Port > auto-name).

Severity.description: How a check's Violations are reported.

SheetStyle.description: How a cross-reference names a partner's sheet.

oneOf.description: By the sheet's title, as in the Projects panel.
By its number in the Projects panel, from 1.

SideValues.description: The spellings of the CPL's side column.

bottom.description: The side column for a part on the bottom.

top.description: The side column for a part on top.

SlotCommand.description: How the drill file writes a slot.

StackupSeeds.description:
A new board's Stackup values, from its Fab Preset. A value left out uses the fallback:
[`DEFAULT_BOARD_THICKNESS`] and [`DEFAULT_COPPER`].

copper.description: The copper thickness of every copper Layer.

StackupSuggestions.description: Suggestions never validate the board or seed its finish or colours.

copper.description: Outer copper thicknesses the fab offers.

items.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

mask_color.description: Solder Mask colours the fab offers.

items.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

description: A REDA Project file (`.reda`). The Project's name is the file stem.

documents.description: The Project's Documents, in Project order (sheet numbering, PDF output).

erc.description:
The ERC severities, `error`, `warning` or `off` per check. Written only when any
differs from its default; a check left out has its default.

fab_presets.description:
The Project's copies of the Fab Presets its Output Jobs use, in the same shape as a
`.redafab` file plus a UUID.

format.description: The file-format version. REDA writes only the current one.

libraries.description:
The Project Libraries: folders relative to the Project folder, `/`-separated.
Written only when there are any.

properties.description:
The Project properties that fill the sheets' title blocks. Written only when any
is set.

schematic.description:
The schematic options: how Nets are named. Written only when any differs from its
default; an option left out has its default.
